content.text: The visible suite now passes (2 passed). The cause was in `solution/core.py`, in `merge`: when a new interval overlapped the last merged interval, the code set the merged end to the new interval's `b` without comparing it to the existing end. A contained interval therefore shrank the result, so `(1, 4)` followed by `(2, 3)` became `(1, 3)`. I changed that one line to `out[-1] = (pa, max(pb, b))`, which is the only file I edited. I didn't touch `tests/`, add dependencies, or change the `merge` signature. I also spot-checked a few other cases by hand (touching with and without `join_touching`, duplicate points, a chain of overlaps, and empty input), and they gave the expected results.
